name: @local/idea-board
description: A resizable, dockable floating idea board with Dream and Nightmare boards: capture ideas, review AI-generated product dreams, run the dreamer or the workspace doctor from the window, and pursue, discard, or squash entries.

scripts.test: node --test --test-isolation=none test/brief.test.mjs test/plugin.test.mjs test/activity.test.mjs test/pursued.test.mjs test/nightmares.test.mjs
